tools.name: search_sets
tools.description: Search LEGO sets by name, set number, theme, year, or price range. Returns matching sets with key details.

tools.name: get_set_details
tools.description: Get full details for a specific LEGO set including current retailer prices, BrickLink market data, and retirement status.

tools.name: get_deals
tools.description: Find the best current LEGO deals — sets selling below RRP at major retailers. Returns sets ranked by discount percentage.

tools.name: get_retiring_soon
tools.description: Find LEGO sets retiring soon. Useful for collectors who want to buy before sets become unavailable and prices increase on the secondary market.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Get price history and trends for a LEGO set across retailers over a given time period.
